headline: Inflation Does Not Ease: 3.96% Annual in First Half of November; Sheinbaum: Will Build High-Tech Hospital
summary: Mexican inflation stayed elevated at 3.96% year on year in the first fortnight of November, according to the headline reported by El Economista.
why: Inflation data guides Banco de México's interest rate decisions, which affect the peso, Mexican bond yields and borrowing costs.
original_headline: Inflación no cede: 3.96% anual en la primera quincena de noviembre,Sheinbaum: construirá hospital de alta tecnología
